original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔州PDP州长候选人兑现1500万奈拉及摩托车承诺，交付遇难矿工家属
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔州人民民主党2027年州长选举候选人穆罕默德·纳米兑现承诺，向在尼日利亚安全与民防部队拘留期间死亡的38名非法矿工家属发放1500万奈拉及摩托车。捐赠通过尼日尔南部基金会进行，由纳米副手达希鲁·阿卜杜勒率团出席交接。报道未说明矿工死亡原因及责任认定。

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔州PDP州长候选人纳米向38名死亡矿工家属兑现1500万奈拉及摩托车承诺
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nami gave out N15million and a motocycle to each of the deceased family of the 38 illegal miners who died in the detention facility of the Nigerian Security and Civil Defence Corps.

key_facts.fact: 捐赠通过尼日尔南部基金会进行，由副州长候选人阿卜杜勒代表纳米出席交接
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The donation was made through the Niger South Foundation... presented to the affected families by a delegation led by Nami’s Deputy Governorship Candidate... Dahiru Abdul

key_facts.fact: 38名非法矿工死于尼日利亚安全与民防部队拘留设施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 38 illegal miners who died in the detention facility of the Nigerian Security and Civil Defence Corps
